implemented_capabilities.capability: Common-cause root-cause analysis over service dependency graph
implemented_capabilities.notes: Cypher finds services reachable (DEPENDS_ON*0..5) from ALL alerting services, then ranks unhealthy-with-nothing-unhealthy-below (deepest failure) over symptoms, using shortestPath to highlight evidence paths. Deterministic graph logic, not an LLM prompt.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Recent change correlation (deployments, commits, authors, teams in a time window)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Parameterised Cypher joins Deployment, Commit, Person and Team within a clamped minutes window and returns minutes_ago.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Blast radius and downstream dependency tracing with depth clamp
implemented_capabilities.notes: Variable-length DEPENDS_ON traversals with min hop per node and a by-tier count; depth is an int clamped to 1..6 before being interpolated into the Cypher string.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Graph-algorithm criticality (PageRank, betweenness, weighted shortest path)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Uses FalkorDB-native CALL algo.pageRank, algo.betweenness and algo.SPpaths with focus-node ranking; availability of algo.betweenness depends on the FalkorDB server version.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Incident memory recall by graph proximity (not text similarity)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Scores resolved past incidents by affected/root-cause links within 2 DEPENDS_ON hops weighted by 1/(1+hops); each investigation becomes an Incident node with ROOT_CAUSE, FOLLOWED, SIMILAR_TO, RESOLVED_BY edges so memory grows.

Agent can only create a pending Action node; /api/actions/{uid}/approve atomically flips pending->executing (FalkorDB write serialisation prevents double execution) and applies graph changes (rollback, open_breaker, scale_up, page_oncall). Actions simulate remediation by mutating graph state; only the optional webhook page reaches the outside world.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Recovery by traversal (health propagation after fix)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Symptom services become healthy once nothing unhealthy is reachable through closed breakers; resolves alerts and incidents accordingly. Operates on a simulated infrastructure graph.

implemented_capabilities.capability: MCP tool server and agent loop with deterministic autopilot fallback
implemented_capabilities.notes: 12 MCP tools; LLM (Ollama/Gemini/OpenAI-compatible) drives the protocol, hidden params (run_id) are injected by the loop not the model, and a deterministic Autopilot policy takes over on provider failure or runs without any LLM and is labelled as such.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Scenario injection and chaos for demo data
implemented_capabilities.notes: Fully synthetic infrastructure (hard-coded services, deployments, people, incidents). The RCA runs on real graph logic but the data is demo-generated.

graph_models_and_cypher: Nodes: Service {name, uid, tier, status, root_fault}, Deployment {version, at, status}, Commit, Person, Team, Database, Alert {status}, Incident {id, status, run_id, steps_taken}, Action {kind, status, risk, target}, Runbook, Page. Edges: DEPENDS_ON {breaker, weight, uid}, DEPLOYED_TO, CONTAINS, AUTHORED_BY, MEMBER_OF, OWNS, ON_CALL {from,to}, READS_FROM/WRITES_TO, FIRED_ON, TRIGGERED_BY, AFFECTED, ROOT_CAUSE, RESOLVED_BY, FOLLOWED, SIMILAR_TO, TARGETS, NOTIFIED, PAGED. Cypher is parameterised; uses FalkorDB-specific constructs (shortestPath only in WITH/RETURN with bound endpoints, pattern comprehensions, algo.pageRank / algo.betweenness / algo.SPpaths). No APOC or Neo4j GDS. Every tool returns its Cypher and touched node/edge uids (evidence trail).
algorithms: Common ancestor/dependency intersection with unhealthy-depth ranking (rootcause.py:find_common_cause)
min-hop BFS-style blast radius with depth cap 6 (read.py:blast_radius)
Fixed-point health recovery over closed-breaker dependency edges (health.py:recompute_health)
Atomic claim of pending action to prevent double execution (actions.py:execute_action)
backend_interfaces: FastAPI: GET /api/health, /api/graph, /api/incidents, /api/scenarios, /api/actions; POST /api/scenarios/{name}, /api/chaos/{service}, /api/reset, /api/runs, /api/actions/{uid}/approve, /api/actions/{uid}/reject; WebSocket /ws event stream

MCP stdio server (python -m sentinel.mcp_server) exposing get_active_alerts, get_service_context, trace_dependencies, blast_radius, find_common_cause, recent_changes, critical_services, chokepoints, failure_path, recall_similar, propose_action, conclude_investigation
frontend_interfaces: Next.js app: Dashboard, GraphCanvas (live graph), AgentTrail (tool-call timeline), ControlPanel (scenarios/chaos/approve), TopBar, WebSocket hook useRunSocket
agent_or_memory_mechanisms: Investigation protocol in SYSTEM_PROMPT driven by an LLM through MCP tools; RunState tracks suspect, repeat incident and proposed actions; nudges force action and paging; memory-guided planning injects a 'memory_match' hint when a past incident shares the root cause; Incident nodes persist learned memory across soft resets; Autopilot is a deterministic fallback with identical interface.
tests_present: backend/tests: test_actions (9), test_agent (6), test_api (1), test_llm (1), test_seed (8), test_tools (15) = about 40 pytest tests that need a live FalkorDB; plus Playwright e2e specs (incident.spec.ts, realtime.spec.ts) and GitHub Actions workflows. Not executed by auditor.
dependency_requirements: Ollama or Gemini/OpenAI-compatible key (optional; Autopilot works without)
security_findings: backend/sentinel/api/main.py:105 - CORS allow_origins includes '*' appended to the configured list with allow_methods/headers '*'; combined with no authentication on POST /api/actions/{uid}/approve, /api/chaos/{service}, /api/reset any web page can trigger state changes
backend/sentinel/api/main.py:114-223 - no authentication or authorization on any route, including action approval (approved_by is hard-coded to 'human')
backend/sentinel/tools/actions.py:~150-165 - urllib.request.urlopen to PAGER_WEBHOOK_URL from environment (operator-controlled; no URL allowlist, SSRF only if env is attacker-controlled)

backend/sentinel/tools/read.py:~60 and ~95 - Cypher built with f-string interpolation of the variable-length bound {d}; d is produced by clamp() to an int 1..6 so not injectable; service names are passed as $params
backend/sentinel/agent/mcp_client.py:~28 - spawns subprocess sys.executable -m sentinel.mcp_server with full os.environ passed to the child (includes API keys); fixed command, not user-controlled
backend/sentinel/tools/incidents.py:~65-70 - generic MATCH (t {uid: $target}) used for ROOT_CAUSE target; parameterised
No hard-coded secrets; .env.example holds empty values. No eval/exec/pickle found.
duplicates_or_overlaps: Incident root-cause analysis and blast-radius traversal (overlaps other RCA, SRE-sentinel and blast-radius repos in the set); approval-gated action pattern overlaps other agent-governance repos.
evidence_drift_relevance: MEDIUM - real propose/approve/execute gating with atomic claim and incident-to-root-cause lineage edges with evidence uid trails, but no provenance supersession or temporal validity windows beyond a recent-deploy cutoff.

strongest_reusable_unit.why: Compact, parameterised, FalkorDB-native Cypher that intersects the dependency closures of all alerting nodes and ranks deepest-unhealthy candidates, paired with a tool result shape (value + cypher + node_uids + edge_uids) that gives every answer an evidence trail; actions.py adds a ready approval-gate state machine.
strongest_reusable_unit.external_runtime_needed: FalkorDB (client falkordb 1.8.0); no LLM needed for the tools; MCP SDK only if the MCP server layer is kept

strategy_rationale: Tools are pure functions over a FalkorDB Graph handle with parameterised Cypher, so the RCA, blast-radius and memory tools can be lifted as an Incident & RCA capability pack; the approval-gate (actions.py) is a candidate shared helper. Keep the synthetic seed data and frontend out of the merge.
